blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Early identification of cerebral palsy (CP) relies on observational assessments of spontaneous infant movement, such as the General Movement Assessment (GMA) and the Baby Observational Selective Control AppRaisal (BabyOSCAR), which require trained raters and substantial scoring time. Existing automated approaches derive hand-engineered features from two-dimensional keypoints, which describe image-plane motion rather than the three-dimensional behavior of individual joints. We present Baby Biomechanical 3D Body (BB3D), an infant-adapted, biomechanical pipeline that estimates joint-angle trajectories from single-camera video. Against a multi-view markerless motion capture reference in 17 infants, BB3D's median Procrustes-aligned error was 17.5~mm for joint centers and 20.4~mm for marker sites. A spatio-temporal transformer, pretrained on BB3D joint-angle trajectories from 1k+ single-camera recordings, and fine-tuned on 550 videos from 350 infants, predicted each individual BabyOSCAR item with a mean within-site AUC of 0.79 and the BabyOSCAR total with a Spearman correlation of 0.86 on held-out recordings. Without being trained on diagnosis, the predicted total separated infants with CP from those without CP with an AUC of 0.86, exceeding a replicated two-dimensional feature classifier (0.67) but below the expert clinician rater's total (0.97). Predicted scores also carried information about functional ability and body distribution, though less than expert clinician scores. These results show that biomechanically grounded representations of monocular video can support scalable, joint-level assessment of selective motor control in infancy
blocks.zh: 脑麻痹(CP)的早期识别依赖于对自发婴儿运动的观察评估,如一般运动评估(GMA)和婴儿观察选择控制Appraisal(BabyOSCAR),它们需要经过训练的测出分数和大量的评分时间. 现有的自动化方法从二维键点中衍生出手动的特征,它描述的是图像-平面运动,而不是单个关节的三维行为. 我们介绍婴儿生物力学三维体(BB3D),这是一条由婴儿适应的生物力学管道,它从单相机视频中估算出联合角轨迹. 对照17个婴儿的多视图无标记运动捕捉参考,BB3D的中位数Procrustes-accessed mistory为联合中心为17.5~mm,标记地为20.4~mm. 一台斯皮提奥-时空变速器,从1k+单相机录制的BB3D相接角轨迹上预作训练,并微调了350个婴儿的550个视频,每台BabyOSCAR物品在站内平均AUC为0.79,而BabyOSCAR总共被搁置录音时Spireman相关比例为0.86. 在未接受诊断培训的情况下,预计患有氯化石蜡的婴儿总数与无氯化石蜡的婴儿总数相去甚远,其AUC为0.86,超过了可复制的二维特性分类器(0.67),但低于专家临床鉴定器的总数(0.97)。 预测的分数还包含关于功能能力和身体分布的信息,尽管低于临床专家的分数。 这些结果表明,单视视频的生物机械化定位可以支持对婴儿期选择性运动控制的可扩展联合评估。

blocks.en: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cerebral palsy (CP) is the most common motor disability of childhood, and early identification plays a critical role in early intervention while the developing nervous system is highly plastic Novak and others, 2017 ; Herskind et al., 2015 . Clinical assessment tools focus on spontaneous infant movement, particularly the quality, variability, and selectivity of movements that emerge during early motor development. Two notable tools are the Prechtl General Movement Assessment (GMA), which evaluates the global quality of spontaneous movements during the writhing and fidgety movement phases Bosanquet et al., 2013 ; Einspieler and Prechtl, 2005 , and the Baby Observational Selective Control AppRaisal (BabyOSCAR) Peyton and others, 2024 ; Sukal‐Moulton and others, 2024 ; Barbosa et al., 2024 ; Peyton and others, 2026 , which evaluates movement at the level of individual joint axes.
blocks.zh: 脑性麻痹(CP)是儿童时期最常见的运动障碍,早期识别在早期干预中起着关键作用,而发育中的神经系统是高度塑料的Novak等人,2017年;Herskind等人,2015年. 临床评估工具侧重于婴儿自发运动,特别是早期运动发育过程中出现的运动的质量,变异性和选择性. 两个值得注意的工具是Prechtl一般运动评估(GMA),该评估评价了Bosanquet等人在曲折和无丝运动阶段自发运动的全球质量, Einspieler和Prechtl,2005年,以及婴儿观察选择控制Appraisal(BabyOSCAR)Peyton等人,2024年;Sukal-Moulton等人, 2024; Barbosa et al., 2024; Peyton 等人, 2026年, 评估单个关节轴的移动水平.

blocks.en: Both instruments require trained raters and substantial scoring time, limiting their scalability and availability across clinical and research settings. The GMA provides a global assessment of movement quality as a singular classification, whereas the BabyOSCAR evaluates the capacity for independent joint control of 32 joints, offering finer resolution into independent or non-independent joint movement patterns (synergy, mirroring, sinuous motion). Automating these assessments could enable efficient, scalable screening for infants with higher probability of CP, while preserving clinically meaningful joint-level information.
blocks.zh: 这两种仪器都需要经过培训的评分员和大量的评分时间,从而限制了其可扩展性和在整个临床和研究环境中的可用性。 全球海洋环境状况评估将移动质量作为单一分类进行全球评估,而BabyOSCAR则评价32个关节的独立联合控制能力,为独立或不独立的联合移动模式(协同、镜像、辛醇运动)提供更精细的分辨率。 使这些评估自动化,可以对氯化石蜡概率较高的婴儿进行有效、可扩展的筛查,同时保留临床上有意义的联合信息。

blocks.en: Recent work has used computer vision and pose estimation to predict clinical outcomes from infant video Chambers and others, 2020 ; Gama and others, 2025 ; Segado et al., 2026 ; Alfano2026TheInfants . However, all existing approaches use sparse two-dimensional keypoint representations and hand-engineered kinematic descriptors joshi2026_mmc_infants , which do not directly encode depth or the full three-dimensional configuration of the body. Consequently, kinematics derived from these points are estimates of image-plane motion rather than measurements of a biomechanical pose. This limitation is particularly important for the BabyOSCAR, whose clinical interpretation depends on the relative three-dimensional behavior of individual joints and on whether movement occurs independently or as part of a broader pattern. In addition, feature-engineering approaches constrain the analysis to motion descriptors hand-selected in advance, potentially preventing the model from discovering clinically relevant patterns in the underlying movement trajectories. Finally, prior automated studies have focused primarily on GMA or CP-related outcomes; to our knowledge, automation of the BabyOSCAR has not previously been attempted.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作利用计算机视觉并作出估计,预测2020年婴儿视频Chamber等人的临床结果;Gama等人,2025年;Segado等人,2026年;Alfano2026年。 内脏 然而,所有现有的方法都使用稀疏的二维键点表示和手动动描述器 joshi2026_mmc_infants ,它们并没有直接编码深度或全身全三维配置. 因此,这些点产生的动能是图像-平面运动的估计,而不是生物力学姿势的测量。 这一限制对于BabyOSCAR来说特别重要,其临床解释取决于单个关节的相对三维行为以及运动是独立发生的还是作为更广泛的模式的一部分. 此外,特征-工程方法将分析限制在手动描述器的手动预选上,有可能阻止模型在基础运动轨迹中发现临床相关模式. 最后,以前的自动化研究主要侧重于全球海洋环境状况评估或与氯化石蜡有关的结果;据我们所知,以前没有尝试过BabyOSCAR的自动化。

blocks.en: In this work, we address these limitations by using a biomechanical pose representation derived from monocular video. Our infant-adapted pipeline combines our previously established cross-model distillation cotton2026crossmodeldistillation with a biomechanical head trained through inverse-kinematics fitting cotton2026b3dbody to estimate anatomically defined joint motion without requiring paired image-to-biomechanics labels. We term this combined framework Baby Biomechanical 3D Body (BB3D). This representation provides a common basis for validating pose estimates and predicting granular clinical movement scores. We investigate whether this biomechanical representation can support both reliable pose estimation and clinically relevant movement assessment.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们通过使用从单视视频中得出的生物力表征来解决这些局限性. 我们的婴儿适应管道结合了我们以前建立的跨模型蒸馏棉2026十字模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二模二 我们称这个综合框架婴儿生物力学三维体(BB3D). 这一表述为验证预测和预测颗粒临床运动得分提供了共同的基础。 我们调查这种生物力学代表是否能够支持可靠的姿势估计和临床相关的运动评估。

blocks.en: The study has two objectives. First, we validate monocular biomechanical estimates against recordings acquired with our established multi-view markerless motion capture (MMMC) system Cotton and others, 2023 in a prospective cohort of 17 infants (33 sessions, 345 recordings total), following a previously described acquisition and preprocessing protocol joshi2026_mmc_infants . The multi-camera reconstruction provides a reference frame for evaluating the accuracy of the marker locations and joint trajectories inferred from a single camera. Second, we train a spatio-temporal transformer Zhu et al., 2023 on the biomechanical trajectories estimated using single-camera recordings from a retrospective cohort (574 infants, 1,284 recordings) to predict clinically meaningful outcomes, including the BabyOSCAR total and per-item scores, CP diagnosis, functional ability, and body distribution. We evaluate various model architecture formulations and compare the resulting performance with existing pose-based and human scoring approaches.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: 1. Multi-camera validation of monocular biomechanical pose estimation in infants. We compare an infant-adapted monocular pose pipeline (BB3D) against a calibrated multi-camera reference and quantify the accuracy of its estimated joint centers and marker sites. 2. Automated prediction of joint-level selective motor control. We develop a spatio-temporal transformer that predicts the 32 per-joint BabyOSCAR items from the biomechanical joint-angle trajectories BB3D estimates in single-camera recordings, and compare its scores with expert ratings in agreement and in dimensionality. 3. Clinical outcomes from predicted scores. We use scores derived from the predicted items to classify CP diagnosis, functional ability and body distribution, and compare their performance with a replicated 2D-keypoint classifier and with the same scores computed from the expert’s ratings.

blocks.en: 2.1 Participants
blocks.zh: 2.1 与会者

blocks.en: This study included infants from seven datasets collected across clinical, laboratory, and home-based settings. The cohort included both preterm and full-term infants, recorded at 28–64 weeks post-menstrual age (PMA). Several datasets included longitudinal recordings, so the same infant could contribute videos at different ages. The multi-camera validation cohort included 17 infants from 33 recording sessions, with 345 recordings evaluated. The single-camera clinical prediction cohort included 574 infants and 1,284 recordings: 1,163 recordings from 505 infants for pretraining, of which 550 BabyOSCAR-scored recordings from 350 infants were used for fine-tuning, and a held-out test set of 121 recordings from 69 infants. Demographic and clinical characteristics of each set, including CP diagnosis, Gross Motor Function Classification System (GMFCS) level, CP body distribution, sex, birth type, and PMA at recording, are summarized in Table 1 .

Twenty-two infants who also had training recordings were excluded from the test set, so no test infant contributed recordings to pretraining or fine-tuning. Of the remaining 69 test infants, 68 had recordings at 50–60 weeks PMA with complete expert BabyOSCAR scores and CP diagnosis, GMFCS, and body distribution information, and were included in the clinical-outcome analyses (Fig. 4 ).

blocks.en: 2.2 Video Acquisition and Preprocessing

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Multi-Camera Recordings
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 多卡梅拉 记录

blocks.en: Multi-camera recordings were acquired with our MMMC system, which captures spontaneous infant movement from eight viewpoints joshi2026_mmc_infants ; Cotton and others, 2023 . Infants lay supine in a calm, alert state; each session comprised 8–10 trials of 50–60 seconds. Calibration, synchronization and tracking followed our previous procedures joshi2026_mmc_infants ; Cotton and others, 2023 .
blocks.zh: 我们的MMMC系统获取了多镜头录音,它从八个角度捕捉自发的婴儿运动,Joshi2026_mmc_infants;Cotton等人,2023年。 婴儿处于平静的戒备状态;每场会议包括8至10次50至60秒的试验。 校准、同步和跟踪遵循了我们先前的程序 Joshi2026_mmc_infants;Cotton等人,2023年。

blocks.en: Two-dimensional keypoints were detected in every view with Sapiens2 khirodkar2026sapiens2 , the successor to Sapiens, which performed best for dense infant keypoints in our earlier comparison joshi2026_mmc_infants ; Khirodkar and others, 2024 . Keypoints from the seven cameras other than the top-down camera were robustly triangulated Roy et al., 2022 ; joshi2026_mmc_infants , treating points with confidence below 0.5 as unobserved, so that the reference was independent of the evaluated view. The triangulated keypoints were reprojected into the top-down camera as the reference for its monocular estimates. BB3D cotton2026b3dbody ; cotton2026crossmodeldistillation was applied to each top-down recording to estimate body pose, segment scales and marker offsets, which forward kinematics converted to 3D joint centers and marker sites.

The infant was tracked with the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) prompted with “baby” sam3 , initialized on the highest-scoring detection, and cropped for pose estimation; this avoided tracking caregivers or other people in the frame. blocks.en: 2.3 Validation of the Biomechanical Pose Estimates
blocks.zh: 2.3 生物力学Pose估计的验证

blocks.en: BB3D estimates from the top-down camera, whose viewpoint most closely approximates the overhead view used in clinical and home recordings, were compared with the triangulated reference at two levels: (1) anatomical joint centers (shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee and ankle, bilaterally; 12 points), compared with the corresponding Sapiens2 joint keypoints; and (2) marker sites (34 sites across the body, face and fingertips), each paired with the corresponding Sapiens2 keypoint (Fig. 1 A). Because marker sites and image keypoints are defined differently (skin over bony landmarks versus learned image landmarks), a pair denotes the closest equivalent point rather than an identical one.
blocks.zh: 从自上而下相机得出的BB3D估计值,其观点最接近临床和家庭录音中使用的俯仰视图,在两个层面与三角参照值进行了比较:(1) 解剖联合中心(肩,肘,腕,臀,膝和踝,双边;12分),与相应的Sapiness2联合键点相比;以及(2) 标记点(全身34处,面和指尖),每个点与相应的Sapiness2键点对齐(图1A)。 由于标记地点和图像的键点定义不同(比骨架地标的皮肤比学到的图像地标),一对表示最接近的等同点,而不是一个完全相同的点.

blocks.en: 2.3.1 Procrustes-aligned error calculation
blocks.zh: 2.3.1 Procrustes对齐误差计算

blocks.en: Because a single view does not determine absolute body size, predicted points were aligned to the reference in each frame by a Procrustes-alignment transform (rotation, translation and uniform scale), fitted separately for each level on the pairs observed in that frame (with a minimum of six needed for evaluation). The error of a point is defined as its Euclidean distance from the reference after alignment, averaged over the frames of a recording. To separate consistent from variable disagreement, residuals are expressed in a trunk-fixed frame defined by the reference hips and shoulders; the systematic offset is the magnitude of the mean residual vector over a recording, and the spread is the root-mean-square residual about it. Errors are summarized as medians and inter-quartile ranges across recordings, over all points and per anatomical location (left and right pooled).
blocks.zh: 由于单一观点不能确定绝对体积,预测的点数通过Procrustes-对齐变换(旋转、翻译和统一尺度)与每个框架的参考值一致,在该框架中观察到的对数上为每个级别分别配置(评价至少需要六个)。 点的误差被定义为其在对齐后与参考物的欧几利得距离,平均在记录框上. 为了与可变的分歧区分开来,残余物以参考臀部和肩部定义的树干固定框架表示;系统抵消是平均残留矢量大于记录的大小,扩散物是其根-正方位的残余物. 错误被概括为中位数和方位间范围,跨越录音,在所有点和每个解剖位置(左右集合).

blocks.en: 2.3.2 Marker site-offset calibration
blocks.zh: 2.3.2 标记器的校准

blocks.en: Sites were evaluated at two stages computed from the same BB3D pose and segment scales. At the standard stage, marker sites were placed at their default positions in the model’s marker configuration and joint centers at their segment origins, discarding BB3D’s predicted marker offsets. At the calibrated stage, each site was displaced by one static offset in the unscaled frame of its segment, shared across all frames and recordings. Offsets were fitted to the triangulated Sapiens2 keypoints by alternating per-frame Procrustes alignment with a closed-form least-squares update of the offsets (Huber loss, 30 mm; weak ridge penalty toward the standard positions), separately for marker sites and joint centers, and leave-one-participant-out. Because the pose was unchanged, any change in error reflects site placement rather than the estimated pose. For reference, we also report the BB3D Body output with its own predicted offsets. Changes between stages were tested with a Wilcoxon signed-rank test on participant-level medians.
blocks.zh: 从相同的BB3D姿势和分层尺度计算,在两个阶段对场地进行了评价。 在标准阶段,标记站点被放在模型标记配置的默认位置上,而联合中心则位于其分区起源,丢弃了BB3D的预测标记抵消. 在校准阶段,每个站点被一个静态冲抵其段段的未缩放框架所取代,并在所有段段和录音中共享。 减值被安装在三角形的Sapians2关键点上,方法是采用封闭式最小方位的减值(Huber损失,30毫米;对标准位置的低脊罚),分别用于标记地点和联合中心,并留一员。 由于姿势没有改变,任何错误变化都反映场地布置情况,而不是估计的姿势。 供参考的是,我们还报告BB3D机构的产出,并附有自己的预测抵销额。 不同阶段之间的变化通过对参与者级别中位数的Wilcoxon签名排名测试。

blocks.en: 2.4 Prediction of Clinical Scores and Outcomes
blocks.zh: 2.4 临床分数和结果预测

blocks.en: Clinical prediction used the single-camera recordings and compared two models built on different representations of movement: a baseline classifier using 2D keypoints estimated with Sapiens Khirodkar and others, 2024 , and our transformer using biomechanical joint-angle ( qpos ) trajectories estimated with BB3D Body cotton2026b3dbody ; cotton2026crossmodeldistillation . We predicted the 32 binary BabyOSCAR items and the aggregate scores derived from them, as well as clinical outcomes: CP diagnosis, functional ability (GMFCS level), and CP body distribution.
blocks.zh: 临床预测使用了单摄像头录音,并比较了基于不同运动表现的两种模型:使用与Sapians Khirodkar等人估算的2D键位的基准分类器,2024年,以及使用与BB3D机体棉质2026b3dbody估算的生物机械联合角(qpos)轨迹的变压器;棉质2026跨模型蒸馏器。 我们预测了32个二进制BabyOSCAR项目及其产生的总分,以及临床结果:CP诊断,功能能力(GMFCS级别),CP体分布.

blocks.en: 2.4.1 Data splitting
blocks.zh: 2.4.1 国家 数据分割

blocks.en: All models shared one participant-level 80/20 train/test split, stratified on CP diagnosis, so every recording of an infant fell on one side. The training side was divided into five cross-validation folds, grouped by participant and by duplicate-recording group. The folds were used to (1) pretrain one transformer model per fold without that fold’s participants; (2) fine-tune one model per fold on the other four folds, using the held-out fold to select the stopping epoch; (3) obtain out-of-fold predictions for every training-side recording from the model that did not train on it; (4) predict the test set as the average of the five fold models; and (5) cross-fit the regression readings of clinical outcomes. The test set was used only for final evaluation.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都共享一个参与者级的80/20列车/测试拆分,在CP诊断上分级,因此每个婴儿的录制都落在一边. 训练方面分为5个交叉验证折叠,由参与者和重复记录组分组. 折叠用于 (1) 每个折叠的预排一个变压器模型,没有该折叠的参与者; (2) 在其他四个折叠上对每个折叠的一个模型进行微调,使用悬浮的折叠来选择停止的时代; (3) 从没有在它上训练的模型中获取每个训练侧记录的倍外预测; (4) 预测测试集为五个折叠模型的平均值;以及 (5) 交叉适应临床结果的回归读数. 测试集只用于最后评估。

blocks.en: 2.4.2 Baseline classifier
blocks.zh: 2.4.2 基线分类器

blocks.en: To compare with prior work, we computed the 38 movement features reported by Segado et al. Segado et al., 2026 using the 2D Sapiens keypoints. This feature set was classified with the auto_sklearn2 AutoML package Feurer et al., 2015 (one-hour search), trained on the training side to separate infants with and without CP, and scored once on the test side. Its per-recording outputs were averaged to the infant level in the same way as the transformer’s, so both were evaluated on the same test infants.
blocks.zh: 与以前的工作相比,我们计算了世嘉多等人报告的38个运动特征。 Segado等人,2026年使用2D Sapiens键位. 此功能集与Auto_sklearn2 AutoML套件Feurer et al., 2015 (1小时搜索)被分类,训练方面将婴儿与无CP分离,并在测试方面得分一次. 其按记录的输出量与变压器的相同,平均达到婴儿水平,因此,两者都在同一试验婴儿上进行了评估。

blocks.en: 2.4.3 BabyOSCAR prediction with a pretrained spatio-temporal transformer
blocks.zh: 2.4.3 BabyOSCAR 预导先经训练的时空变压器

blocks.en: We used 44 BB3D joint-angle ( qpos ) channels at 30 Hz, excluding root, finger, metatarsophalangeal, and knee-rotation channels. The transformer was pretrained as a masked autoencoder on randomly sampled 10-second windows. Each window was divided into 30 patches of 10 frames, producing 1,320 1{,}320 channel–patch tokens. The two-layer, 256-dimensional, four-head encoder used MotionBERT’s factorized spatio-temporal attention Zhu et al., 2023 . Seventy percent of channels were masked for the full window, and a one-layer decoder reconstructed them. Pretraining ran for 200 epochs using all eligible processed recordings, excluding test participants and the held-out fold.
blocks.zh: 我们用了44个BB3D 组合角(qpos)频道 在30 Hz,不包括根,手指,元代索法兰基,以及膝盖旋转通道. 变压器在随机抽取的10秒窗口上作为蒙面自动编码器进行预训. 每个窗口被分为30个补丁10帧,产生1,320 1{,}320通道–patch令牌. 双层,256维,四头的编码器使用了MotionBERT的因子化的时空注意力Zhu等人,2023年. 70%的频道为全窗遮盖,一个一层的解码器重建了它们. 预训会利用所有合格经处理的录音(不包括测试参与者和搁置的折叠),为200个时代跑步。

blocks.en: For fine-tuning, the decoder was removed and each of the 550 scored training recordings was represented by six evenly spaced 10-second windows. The encoder processed each window with all channels visible. Time-averaged channel embeddings were normalized and averaged across windows, yielding one 256-dimensional embedding per channel. Each BabyOSCAR item used a learned weighted combination of these embeddings, initialized from the item’s joint, neighboring, and contralateral channels; items without corresponding input channels were initialized using all channels. The item representation was combined with learned joint-type and body-side tags and passed through a shared MLP to predict the item logit. Fine-tuning updated the final encoder layer and prediction components using gradient-norm-balanced binary cross-entropy across the 32 items. We applied left–right mirroring augmentation with probability 0.5, selected checkpoints using the held-out training fold, trained three random seeds, and averaged their test-set probabilities.
blocks.zh: 对于微调,解码器被移除,550分的训练录音中每张都由6个均匀间隔10秒的窗口代表. 编码器以可见的所有通道处理每个窗口. 平均时间的信道嵌入已正常化,平均跨窗口,每个信道嵌入256维。 每个BabyOSCAR项目都使用这些嵌入物的学得加权组合,这些嵌入物从项目的连接、邻接和反边通道初始化;没有相应输入通道的项目则使用所有通道初始化。 物品说明与学到的联合类型和身体侧面标记相结合,通过一个共享的MLP来预测物品的登录. 微调更新了最终编码器层和预测组件,使用梯度-规范平衡的二进制横跨32项. 我们应用了左-右镜放大法,概率为0.5, 选择了使用搁置式训练折叠的检查站, 训练了三个随机种子, 并估计了测试的概率。

blocks.en: The total was the sum of the 32 item probabilities of independent joint motion including limb totals, right and left summed joint totals and a laterality index (right minus left) were derived from the items as in the manual assessment Peyton and others, 2024 ; Sukal‐Moulton and others, 2024 ; Barbosa et al., 2024 ; Peyton and others, 2026 . To compare the structure of predicted and expert scores, we ran a principal component analysis on the 32-item correlation matrix of held-out recordings (out of fold and test) with all items rated, separately for expert scores and predicted probabilities. We report cumulative variance explained, the components needed for 80% and 90%, and the participation ratio, an effective number of dimensions computed from the eigenvalue spread (1 if one component carries all variance, 32 if it is spread evenly). Bands are participant-clustered bootstrap 95% intervals (200 resamples).
blocks.zh: 总数是独立联合运动32项概率的总和,包括四肢总数、左右连结总数和后期指数(右减左),来自各项目,如《2024年Peyton等人手册评估》;Sukal__Moulton等人, 2024年; Barbosa 等人, 2024年; Peyton 等人, 2026年. 为了比较预测和专家分数的结构,我们对(不折叠和测试)被搁置的录音与所有被评为专家分数和预测概率的32项相关矩阵进行了主要组成部分分析。 我们报告累积差异,说明80%和90%所需的组件,以及参与比率,这是从均值差值计算的有效维数(如果一个组件包含所有差异,如果分布均匀,则为32个)。 乐队是参与者集群的靴套,间隔95%(200个复标)。

blocks.en: 2.4.4 Clinical outcomes from predicted BabyOSCAR scores
blocks.zh: 2.4.4 预测BabyOSCAR分数的临床结果

blocks.en: Outcomes were read at the infant level from recordings at 50–60 weeks post-menstrual age (PMA), averaged within each session and then across sessions. Readings were fixed scores (the negative total, or the asymmetry ∑ | R − L | \sum|R-L| ) or regularized regressions on six summaries or all 32 items, cross-fitted over the folds. Tasks were CP versus no CP (NCP), and, among infants with CP, GMFCS III–V versus I–II and unilateral versus bilateral CP. Additionally, each CP subgroup (GMFCS III–V, GMFCS I–II, unilateral, bilateral) was compared with the NCP group, using the negative total or the asymmetry. The same readings were taken from the expert’s item scores on the same infants and compared with the model’s using a paired, infant-level bootstrap, separately for the test set and the out-of-fold training side.
blocks.zh: 在婴儿一级从50至60周的月经后年龄的录音中读取结果,平均在每次会议期间,然后在休会期间。 读数是固定的分数(负总分,或不对称的 QQ R − L → sum|R-L|),或者在6个总分或全部32个项目上进行正规化回归,在折叠上交叉调节. 任务是 " 氯化石蜡与无氯化石蜡 " (NCP),在有氯化石蜡的婴儿中, " GMFCS III-V-I-II " 和 " 单边与双边氯化石蜡 " 。 此外,每个CP分组(GMFCS III-V、GMFCS I-II、单边、双边)都与NCP分组进行了比较,采用了负总和或不对称。 同样的读数也取自专家对同一个婴儿的分数,与该模型使用一对婴儿级的靴子作比较,分别用于测试单元和训练外侧。

blocks.en: 2.4.5 Model experiments
blocks.zh: 2.4.5 模型实验

blocks.en: Each experiment changed one aspect of the base model, keeping its folds, encoders and seeds: • adding CP diagnosis and GMA rating heads; • adding heads that predict the total, limb totals, side totals and laterality directly; • training only on recordings at or after 40 weeks PMA, evaluated on the same ≥ \geq 40-week recordings; • replacing the shared item network with one network per item.
blocks.zh: 每一个实验都改变了基准模型的一个方面,保留了它的折叠,编码器和种子: • 增加了CP诊断和GMA评级头; • 增加了预测总数,肢体总数,侧总数和后期的直接头; • 只在PMA40周或40周后进行录音培训,在同一\\\ geq40周录音上评价; • 用每个项目一个网络取代共享项目网络.

blocks.en: adding CP diagnosis and GMA rating heads;
blocks.zh: 增加CP诊断和全球海洋环境状况评估评级负责人;

blocks.en: adding heads that predict the total, limb totals, side totals and laterality directly;
blocks.zh: 增加直接预测总数、肢体总数、侧总数和延后性的头;

blocks.en: training only on recordings at or after 40 weeks PMA, evaluated on the same ≥ \geq 40-week recordings;
blocks.zh: 只在40周后或40周后进行录音培训,并用同样的 \\\\\\\\40周录音进行评价;

blocks.en: replacing the shared item network with one network per item.
blocks.zh: 将共享项目网络替换为每个项目一个网络。

blocks.en: 2.4.6 Evaluation

Because recruitment datasets differed in referral pathway and outcome prevalence, headline metrics were computed within dataset, with pooled values alongside. Items were scored by ROC-AUC within each dataset of at least 20 recordings, weighted by discordant pairs and averaged over the 28 items whose joints the channels measure. The total and derived scores were scored by the mean within-dataset Spearman correlation, with mean absolute error and calibration slope. Out-of-fold predictions are mildly optimistic, because the same fold selected the stopping epoch; test predictions averaged the five fold models. Model experiments were compared with the base model on the same recordings, using participant-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 由于征聘数据集在转诊途径和结果普及率方面各不相同,因此在数据集内计算了标题计量标准,并附有集合值。 ROC-AUC在至少20个录音记录的每个数据集中对项目进行打分,以不相容的对数加权,并平均衡量频道连接度的28个项目。 总和派生的分数由平均数据集Spearman的关联性得分,平均绝对误差和校准斜率. 外倍数预测略为乐观,因为同一折叠选择了停止的时代;测试预测平均了五个折叠模型. 利用参与者集群的靴子置信间隔,将模型实验与同一录音基模型进行了比较。

blocks.en: 3 RESULTS
blocks.zh: 3项结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Validation of the Biomechanical Pose Estimates
blocks.zh: 3.1 生物力学Pose估计的验证

blocks.en: We analyzed 345 recordings from 17 participants; the held-out camera’s Sapiens2 detections had a median reprojection error of 5.4 pixels (IQR 2.1). With the standard model configuration, the median Procrustes-aligned error was 26.9 mm for joint centers and 30.5 mm for marker sites, mostly systematic (offsets 24.8 and 25.9 mm vs. spreads 10.9 and 16.5 mm) and largest at the hips (Fig. 1 A, B, and 2 ). Leave-one-participant-out calibration reduced these to 17.5 and 20.4 mm, improving all 17 participants (Wilcoxon p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ; Figs. 1 B and 2 ), by correcting the systematic offset (13.6 and 14.5 mm) while leaving the spread unchanged. Reduction was largest at the hips (Figs. 1 B and 2 ). Held-out offsets performed almost identically to offsets fitted on all participants (17.5 vs. 17.3 mm and 20.4 vs. 20.1 mm).

blocks.en: 3.2 Automated BabyOSCAR scoring
blocks.zh: 3.2 自动婴儿奥斯卡分数

blocks.en: On the 121 held-out test recordings from 69 infants, the predicted BabyOSCAR total, computed as the sum of the 32 predicted item probabilities, agreed closely with the expert’s total (within-dataset Spearman ρ \rho = 0.78, 95% CI [0.65-0.84]; pooled ρ \rho = 0.86), with a mean absolute error of 3.5 items (Fig. 3 A). Agreement extended to the individual items. Across the 28 items whose joint is tracked by BB3D, the mean within-site AUC was 0.79 (0.74-0.82) (Fig. 3 B). Item AUCs ranged from 0.73 for right hip internal/external rotation to 0.88 for right shoulder abduction/adduction, and all 32 items exceeded the accuracy of always predicting the most common score at a 0.5 threshold.
blocks.zh: 关于69个婴儿的121份搁置试验录音,BabyOSCAR的预测总数,即32项预测概率的总和,与专家的总数(数据集Spearman ^\rho = 0.78,95% CI [0.65-0.84];集合 ±rho = 0.86)非常一致,平均绝对错误为3.5项(图3 A)。 协定适用于个别项目。 在BB3D追踪到的28件联合物品中,现场AUC的平均值为0.79(0.74-0.82)(图3 B)。 项目AUC从右臀内侧/外侧旋转0.73到右肩绑架/诱导0.88不等,所有32项都超过了总是以0.5阈值预测最常见的分数的准确性.

blocks.en: The predicted item scores, however, had a lower dimensionality than the expert’s. Principal component analysis showed that 18 components explained 80% of the variance in the expert’s 32 item scores (participation ratio 6.6), compared with just 1 component for the predicted scores (participation ratio 1.5) (Fig. 3 C).
blocks.zh: 但是,预测的项目分数比专家的分数低。 主要组成部分分析显示,18个组成部分解释了专家32项分数的80%的差异(参与比率6.6),而预测分数只有1项(参与比率1.5)(图3 C)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Clinical outcomes from predicted BabyOSCAR scores
blocks.zh: 3.3 预测BabyOSCAR分数的临床结果

blocks.en: Next, we investigated whether the predicted item scores carry the same clinical outcome information as the expert’s. Each infant was represented by a single 32-item vector, the mean of their predicted item probabilities over sessions at 50–60 weeks PMA. This window corresponds to the fidgety-movement period, in which GMA is assessed Einspieler and Prechtl, 2005 and in which the BabyOSCAR has been validated for outcome prediction Barbosa et al., 2024 ; Sukal‐Moulton and others, 2024 ; Peyton and others, 2024 ; Peyton and others, 2026 . To avoid fitting a model to the small clinical groups, each outcome was read from a fixed summary of the items, as the BabyOSCAR is read clinically. The total score was used for CP diagnosis and classification of functional ability, with lower totals indicating greater need for mobility support. Asymmetry, the sum over the 16 movements of the absolute right–left difference, was used for distinguishing body distribution types (unilateral vs. bilateral) in the CP versus NCP groups, as well as classifying body distribution within the CP subset. The expert’s item scores were summarized identically on the same infants, providing a reference for the clinical information contained in the BabyOSCAR itself.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们调查了预测的项目分数是否与专家的临床结果信息相同。 每个婴儿都有一个32项矢量作为代表,这是他们预测在50-60周PMA会期内可能得到的物品的平均值。 这个窗口与Fidgety-movement时期相对应,其中2005年评估了全球海洋环境状况评估(Einspieler和Prechtl),并在其中验证了BabyOSCAR对结果预测(Barbosa等人,2024年);Sukal-Moulton等人, 2024年; 佩顿等人, 2024; 佩顿等人, 2026. 为了避免给小的临床组装模型,每个结果都从物品的固定摘要中读取,因为BabyOSCAR在临床上读取。 总分用于CP诊断和功能能力分类,总分较低表明更需要流动支持. 不对称,即绝对右-左差异的16个运动的总和,用于区别CP组和NCP组中的机体分布类型(单体对双边),以及CP子组内机体分布的分类. 专家对同一婴儿的分数作了同样的总结,为BabyOSCAR本身所载的临床资料提供了参考。

blocks.en: Each outcome was evaluated on two sets of infants (Fig. 4 ). The primary analysis used the 68 test-set infants, which no model saw during training or model selection. Because the test set contains few infants with CP, we also report the 324 validation-set infants, each predicted by the cross-validation model that had not been trained on them. The fine-tuning epoch for each cross-validation model was chosen using the item loss on its validation fold, so training-set estimates may be slightly optimistic; the test-set estimates are not affected by this selection.
blocks.zh: 对两组婴儿进行了评价(图4)。 初步分析使用了68个测试组婴儿,在培训或选择模型时没有看到这些模型。 由于测试集中包含的有CP的婴儿很少,因此我们也报告了324个验证组的婴儿,每个都由没有对其进行过训练的交叉验证模型预测. 每个交叉验证模型的微调时段都是在其验证折叠上使用项目损失来选择的,因此训练集估计值可能略为乐观;测试集估计值不受这一选择的影响.

blocks.en: On the test set, the predicted total separated infants later diagnosed with CP (n=22) from infants without CP (n=31) with an AUC of 0.86 (95% CI 0.74–0.95), compared with 0.97 (0.92–1.00) for the expert’s total and 0.67 (0.52–0.81) for our implementation of the 38-feature classifier of Segado et al. Segado et al., 2026 , trained directly on CP versus NCP and evaluated on the same test set of infants (Fig. 4 B). On the validation set (115 CP, 143 NCP), the AUCs were 0.88 (0.83–0.92) for the predicted total and 0.98 (0.96–0.99) for the expert’s (Fig. 4 A).
blocks.zh: 在测试中,预测的分离婴儿总数后来从无CP(n=22)的婴儿中诊断出为0.86(95%为CI 0.74-0.95),而专家总数为0.97(0.92-1.00),我们实施Segado等人的38度分类法为0.67(0.52-0.81)。 Segado等人,2026年,直接接受关于CP对NCP的培训,并在同一套测试婴儿上进行评估(图4 B)。 在验证组(115 CP,143 NCP)上,AUCs的预测总数是0.88(0.83–0.92),专家的预测总数是0.98(0.96–0.99)(图4 A).

blocks.en: Classification of CP diagnosis using stratification based on functional ability (GMFCS level) and body distribution showed that separation from the NCP group was strongest for those with GMFCS III-V and for bilateral CP (Fig. 4 C, E). On the validation set, the predicted total reached an AUC of 0.97 for GMFCS III–V versus NCP and 0.86 for GMFCS I–II versus NCP (expert 0.99 for both); predicted asymmetry separated unilateral CP versus NCP with an AUC of 0.77 (expert 0.92), and 0.94 for bilateral CP from NCP (expert 0.99). The test set showed the same pattern (GMFCS III–V 1.00, I–II 0.82, unilateral 0.78, and bilateral 0.89; expert 1.00, 0.97, 0.99 and 0.92), on 3, 7, 9 and 12 infants with CP, respectively.
blocks.zh: 根据功能能力(GMFCS级别)和身体分布对氯化石蜡进行分层诊断的分类表明,对于具有GMFCS III-V和双边氯化石蜡(图4 C,E)的人来说,与NCP组的分离最为强烈。 在验证方面,预测的总量达到:GMFCS III-V对NCP的AUC为0.97,GMFCS I-II对NCP的AUC为0.86(专家均为0.99);预测的不对称将单方氯化石蜡与NCP分离,AUC为0.77(专家为0.92),双边氯化石蜡与NCP为0.94(专家为0.99)。 测试组显示的模式相同(GMFCS III-V 1.00,I-II 0.82,单边0.78和双边0.89;专家1.00,0.97,0.99和0.92),分别对3,7,9和12名携带CP的婴儿.

blocks.en: Among infants with CP, the predicted and expert totals both distinguished GMFCS III–V from GMFCS I–II with an AUC of 1.00 on the test set (3 vs. 7 infants), and with AUCs of 0.79 and 0.83 on the validation set (34 vs. 28) (Fig. 4 D). Predicted asymmetry distinguished unilateral from bilateral CP with an AUC of 0.65 (0.35–0.93) on the test set (9 vs. 12 infants) and 0.72 on the validation set (40 vs. 69), compared with 0.81 and 0.87 for the expert’s scores (Fig. 4 F).
blocks.zh: 在有氯化石蜡的婴儿中,预测的和专家的总数均与GMFCS III-V和GMFCS I-II区分开来,试验组的AUC为1.00(3对7个婴儿),验证组的AUC为0.79和0.83(34对28)(图4 D)。 预测的非对称性将单边CP与双边CP区分开来,在测试组(9对12个婴儿)上为0.65(0.35-0.93),在验证组(40对69)上为0.72,而专家的分数为0.81和0.87(图4 F)。

blocks.en: 3.4 Model Experiments
blocks.zh: 3.4 模型实验

blocks.en: Finally, to test which design choices contributed to performance, we compared four variants with the reference model on the same recordings and infants: (1) additional CP and GMA heads, (2) additional heads for the total, limb, side and laterality scores, (3) training only on recordings at or beyond 40 weeks PMA, and (4) a separate classifier for each item. None of these changes significantly altered performance for any of the metrics; for every metric, the 95% confidence interval of the difference from the reference included zero. We therefore retained the simpler reference design.
blocks.zh: 最后,为了测试哪些设计选择有助于性能,我们比较了四个变体与相同录音和婴儿的参考模型:(1) 额外的CP和GMA头,(2) 总分、四肢、边分和后分数的额外头,(3) 仅在40周之后进行录音培训,以及(4) 每个项目单独分类。 这些变化都没有显著改变任何指标的性能;对于每个指标,与参考值差异的95%的置信间隔包括零。 因此,我们保留了较简单的参考设计。

blocks.en: 4 DISCUSSION
blocks.zh: 4 讨论

blocks.en: This study shows that three-dimensional biomechanical information estimated from monocular video can predict joint-level selective motor control and clinical outcomes in infants. Unlike previous approaches based on image-plane keypoints Chambers and others, 2020 ; Gama and others, 2025 ; Segado et al., 2026 ; Alfano2026TheInfants , our representation describes how each joint moves in three dimensions, the level at which the BabyOSCAR is defined.
blocks.zh: 这项研究显示,从单视视频中估算出的三维生物力学信息可以预测婴儿的关节级选择性运动控制和临床结果. 与以往基于图像-平面键点的方法不同, Chambers等人, 2020年; Gama等人, 2025年; Segado等人, 2026年; Alfano2026 我们的代表讲述了每个联合体如何在三个层面移动,

blocks.en: Compared with a multi-camera reference, BB3D estimates from a single camera agreed to within approximately 2 cm after calibration of marker-site placement (17.5 mm for joint centers, 20.4 mm for marker sites). Calibration removed mostly systematic error, left frame-to-frame spread unchanged and transferred to held-out infants, indicating that residual error largely reflects differences in landmark definition rather than pose.
blocks.zh: 与多相机参考相比,BB3D在校准标记地点位置(联合中心17.5毫米,标记地点20.4毫米)后在大约2厘米内从商定的单相机中作出估计。 校准大多消除了系统性错误,左框对框的分布没有改变,并转移到被搁置的婴儿身上,这表明残余错误在很大程度上反映了标志性定义上的区别,而不是摆设.

blocks.en: The predicted BabyOSCAR agreed well with expert scoring (within-dataset ρ = 0.78 \rho=0.78 for the total; mean item AUC 0.79), and, although trained only on BabyOSCAR items, separated CP from NCP (AUC 0.86). Pooled agreement exceeded within-dataset agreement ( ρ \rho = 0.86 vs. 0.78), but this need not reflect site confounding: the transformer sees only scale-normalized joint-angle trajectories, so image-level shortcuts are unlikely, and each dataset source spans a narrower range of ages and impairment. Within-dataset agreement is thus a conservative lower bound, and pooled agreement reflects sensitivity across the full developmental spectrum.
blocks.zh: 预测的BabyOSCAR与专家评分完全一致(数据总和=0.78\rho=0.78;平均项目AUC 0.79),虽然只接受BabyOSCAR项目的培训,但将CP与NCP分离(AUC 0.86)。 集合协议超过了数据集内部的协议(^\rho = 0.86 vs. 0.78),但这不需要反映站点混淆:变压器只看到规模化的常态合角轨迹,因此图像级快捷键不太可能,每个数据集源都跨过较窄的年代和减值范围. 因此,数据集内协定是一个保守的低约束,集合协定反映了整个发展范围的敏感性。

blocks.en: A replication of the 2D feature classifier of Segado et al. Segado et al., 2026 , without depth or temporal structure, achieved an AUC of 0.67 for CP versus NCP on the same test infants, compared with 0.86 for the transformer. The expert nevertheless remained more accurate, and the structure of the scores suggests why. The expert’s item scores had a participation ratio more than four times that of the predicted scores (6.6 vs. 1.5 effective dimensions). The model compresses the BabyOSCAR onto a few shared axes, dominated by global movement quality, whereas the clinician scores each joint using information the model does not receive: whether a movement is isolated or part of a mirroring or synergy pattern, its timing, and the context of the whole observation Peyton and others, 2024 ; Sukal‐Moulton and others, 2024 ; Barbosa et al., 2024 ; Peyton and others, 2026 . Part of the expert’s higher dimensionality may also be item-level rating noise, so the ratio bounds, rather than measures, what the model misses.
blocks.zh: 世嘉多等人的2D特性分类器的复制. Segado等人,2026年,没有深度或时间结构,在同一试验婴儿身上,CP对NCP的AUC为0.67,而变压器的AUC为0.86。 然而,专家仍然更准确,计分结构表明了原因。 专家项目分数的参与率是预测分数(6.6对1.5有效维度)的四倍以上。 该模型将BabyOSCAR压缩到几个共享轴上,以全球移动质量为主,而临床医生使用该模型没有收到的信息对每个关节进行评分:运动是孤立的,还是镜像或协同模式的一部分,时机,以及整个观测Peyton等人的背景,2024年;Sukal__Moulton等人, 2024年; Barbosa 等人, 2024年; Peyton 等人, 2026年. 专家较高维度的一部分也可能是物品级的评级噪音,因此比例限制而不是衡量模型错过了什么。

blocks.en: This difference appears in the stratified results. In distinguishing between CP, GMFCS III–V versus NCP groups, the transformer performed nearly as well as the expert (AUC 0.97 vs. 0.99), as infants who have higher GMFCS levels have less independent motion expressed across many joints, captured by a global axis. The gap widened for infants with CP with GMFCS I-II and for distinctions that depend on specific joints or sides, with higher amounts of independent joint motion and laterality within CP. Automated scoring could therefore already support scalable screening for infants with GMFCS levels III-V, while infants with GMFCS I-II and unilateral presentations still benefit from expert assessment.
blocks.zh: 这种差异出现在分层结果中。 在区别氯化石蜡、GMFCS III-V类与NCP类之间时,变压器几乎与专家一样(AUC 0.97 vs. 0.99),因为GMFCS水平较高的婴儿在许多关节间表达的独立运动较少,被一个全球轴所捕获。 与GMFCS I-II的氯化石蜡有关的婴儿和取决于具体关节或侧面的区别的差距扩大,在氯化石蜡内独立联合运动和延后性的程度更高。 因此,自动评分可以支持以GMFCSIII-V级对婴儿进行可扩展的筛选,而采用GMFCSI-II级和单边介绍的婴儿仍受益于专家评估。

blocks.en: 4.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.1 限制

blocks.en: The model lacks event detection and timing and does not label the movement patterns, such as mirroring or synergies, that explain its scores. Source differences in age and impairment mean that pooled and within-dataset metrics bound performance rather than measuring it exactly. GMFCS level and body distribution information were often missing, so within-CP and subgroup comparisons rest on few infants and wide confidence intervals. Monocular accuracy was validated only from a laboratory top-down camera, not under clinical and home conditions or in infants younger than our validation set, such as those in the NICU.
blocks.zh: 该模型缺乏事件检测和时间,并且不标注运动模式,如镜像或协同,以解释其得分. 来源在年龄和减值方面的差异意味着集合和数据集内的衡量尺度约束着业绩,而不是精确地衡量业绩。 GMFCS的级别和身体分布信息往往缺失,因此在氯化石蜡内部和亚类的比较依赖于很少的婴儿和广泛的置信间隔. 只有实验室自上而下的照相机才能验证单体精度,在临床和家庭条件下,或在比我们的鉴定组更年轻的婴儿,如NICU的鉴定组中。

blocks.en: 4.2 Future Directions
blocks.zh: 4.2 未来方向

blocks.en: Future models could ingest clinicians’ notes on movement patterns and event timing for each joint, or detect mirroring and synergies explicitly, to approach the dimensionality of expert scoring. Our datasets also include birth history information, clinical labels and longitudinal recordings, which could support causal models of infants’ motor trajectories despite missing labels.
blocks.zh: 未来的模型可以吸收临床医生关于每一关节的移动模式和事件时间的说明,或者明确检测镜像和协同作用,以便处理专家评分的维度问题。 我们的数据集还包括出生史信息、临床标签和纵向录音,这些可以支持婴儿运动轨迹的因果模型,尽管缺少标签。

blocks.en: In summary, BB3D provides monocular three-dimensional estimates of infant movement within approximately 2 cm. Temporal models built on these estimates outperform image-plane approaches in predicting selective motor control and clinical outcomes, and approach expert performance in identifying infants with CP GMFCS III-V, a step toward scalable, joint-level infant motor assessment.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,BB3D提供了大约2厘米范围内婴儿运动的单光三维估计. 基于这些估计的时态模型在预测选择性运动控制和临床结果方面超过了图像-平面方法,在鉴定婴儿时采用了专家的性能,采用CP GMFCS III-V,这是朝着可扩展的、联合的婴儿运动评估迈出的一步。
